name: Winter Coat
body:
Your fur or feathers are adapted to conditions of extreme cold and your coloration matches icy conditions.

Prerequisite(s): Bestial species.

Benefit(s): You treat cold environments as one step less severe and gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves to resist the effects of cold climate. Your white plumage or fur also grants you a +2 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks in snowy or icy conditions.
